# Check of M0-a-02: closing check of the hardening round S4 (lane `check/M0-a-02-close-s4`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-11-13)

Leg 1 of the merged round M0-a-02 S4 → M0-a-06 S10 (J757, J776, J777, J797).

## Who ran it, and how

Lane `check/M0-a-02-close-s4` ran in Claude Code, in a Claude Code cloud container (Linux x64, Node 24.12.0).
`tools/machine_profile.py --id` printed `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib`, the expected id. The
first seat ran on 2026-11-13 from 05:05. It handed its long RELATED run to the waiter (J714). The chain finished at
09:00 and a fresh seat of the lane (Fable 5.2, the same machine, the same id and Node) finished the check from the
finished logs. The fresh seat re-ran no finished log. It read the round's diff, the mutant logs and their exit files,
the probe outputs and the 47 exit files of the chain itself, summed the 45 JSON reports (`related/sum.py`), ran one
label probe of its own (the canary on the head's registry, LINE 4 below), and re-ran the fast gates and
`landed:verify` on the tree.

This seat is an implementer-side, independent closing checker. It is not the item's author: the author of this round is
`build/M0-a-02-fix-s4` (L-0837, choices C-0505).

How the seat worked:

* It changed no file of the item and ran no git command.
* Its probes and mutants were planned (`plan.md` in the lane's scratch) before it read the author's notes section or
  CHECKPOINT detail.
* The pre-round images were read from the head b3ed9b2e's objects by a Python reader (`gitread.py`, no git). A walk of
  that head's whole `plat/` tree against the working tree (`treediff.py`; 2 552 files) names the round's whole diff:
  six changed files of the item's owns, one new test file, and `CLEAN-ROOM.md`, `docs/build/choices.md`,
  `docs/build/checks/M0-a-02-notes.md`, `docs/build/landed/M0-a-02.json` and `landed/build-M0-a-02-notes.json`.
  Nothing else under `plat/` differs from the head.
* `tools/test_budget.py` printed 1 every time, so every run used 1 worker.
* Mutants and probes ran in the seat's own mirror, `/home/user/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-a-02/s4/mirror` (a copy of
  `plat/`; 390 links, none leaving the mirror; the realpath of `@plat/kernel` inside it). Its clean baseline was
  120 / 120. Every planted change was restored and checked byte for byte (`diff -rq` of the mirror's packages against
  the tree: no difference).
* The tree's NEAR and RELATED runs were one re-entrant chain (`…/s4/related/chain.sh`), one test process at a time.
  While it ran, mutants ran one at a time in the mirror, as `test_budget.py --mutants` (1) allows.

Lane scratch: `/home/user/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-a-02/s4/` (`logs/` the gates, `mut/` one log and exit file per
mutant, `probe/` the LINE 4 probes and the census, `related/` the chain).

## Verdict: PASS

All four lines are confirmed with this lane's own evidence. No blocker was found. The 31 mutant runs went as planned:
every mutant red, every control as expected. The refusal census has not risen. Every gate exits 0 except RELATED's
three chunks that hold the head's declared reds: RELATED at 1 000 runs is 7 721 passed of 7 729, with 7 failed and 1
standing skip, and the 7 are Q152's six bands tests and the J772 canary. Each of the seven was reproduced by this lane
on the head's registry in the mirror with the same failure, so none is the raise's and none is a finding.

* LINE 1 is **FIXED and PINNED**.
* LINE 2 is **PINNED**.
* LINE 3 is **FIXED as the line reads**; one clause the line itself asked for is wrong on the code (notes row
  N-s4c-1, not a blocker).
* LINE 4 is **MEASURED and DECLARED**; RELATED shows no red outside the head's declared reds.

## (1) The four lines, each with this seat's own evidence

### LINE 1 — Q79 / RQ2 / RL4: the `shape` row and the version raise. CONFIRMED fixed and pinned

Read: `src/arena/roles.json` against the head's image. `"version": 1` became `2`; one row was appended, `{"id": 56,
"name": "shape", "kind": "vertex", "rank": 56, "structural": false, "indexed": false, "knot": false, "since": 2}`
(J776 R7: not indexed, rank 56 = id, since 2); the `$comment` gained the two sentences the line asks for. Rows 0 – 55
are byte-identical to the head's. `registry.ts` differs in one comment line (`RoleInfo.rank`); its emitted JS with
comments removed is identical (d99ba51bf5e2d2b5 on both sides). No export changed: `arena/index.ts` and the barrel are
byte-identical to the head.

`roles.test.ts` is re-pinned as the line asks: the version-1 snapshot test is unchanged but for one comment; the
version-2 test holds `ROLE_REGISTRY_VERSION` 2, length 57, row 56 whole, every rank equal to its id; the lookup test
holds `roleIdOf('shape')` = 56 and `roleInfo(57)` throwing; the malformed-document test uses `doc.version + 1` and
`doc.roles.length`.

The new pin `test/arena/registry-version.test.ts` reads io/ through its exports and edits nothing there. Its title and
header say it is the byte format's reading, never a promise that an old cache is current (R17). A chunk patched to
version 1 at offset 6 and re-hashed with `H128` decodes, and the loaded arena re-encodes to the original version-2
bytes and refs; a chunk patched to 3 is refused as a corrupt cache whose detail names "a chunk written under a newer
role registry".

Mutants (mirror; `vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --project kernel test/arena/roles.test.ts
